title: Ride with a top-notch captain!
text:
We enjoyed a magnificent afternoon for a November 1st, in the company of a captain who was as friendly as she was warm (a big thank you to Marie!).

The boat was perfect for 4 people and the 3-hour ride was ideal. We were able to go as far as the old port and even enjoy a little swim on the way back.
author: arthurtE6785GQ

title: Marie - 5 Stars!
text:
We had an absolutely wonderful experience on our sunset cruise, and a huge part of that was thanks to our skipper, Marie!

Marie was incredibly sweet, knowledgeable, and attentive throughout the entire experience. She shared so much interesting history about Spain and gave us great information about the different sights we were seeing along the Barcelona coastline. She even took the time to explain how the sailboat worked, which made the experience that much more enjoyable!
